items.summary: A US-Iran agreement to extend the ceasefire between the two countries has been signed and is now in effect, a White House official has confirmed to the BBC.
items.summary_zh: 美国-伊朗延长两国停火协议已经签署,现在生效,一位白宫官员已向英国广播公司确认.

items.title: 'I buried my parents one day after the other' - Ebola mourners learn how to grieve safely
items.title_zh: 埃博拉哀悼者学会如何安全地哀悼,
items.summary: Nyamurongo cemetery in Bunia, a city in north-eastern Democratic Republic of Congo that is the epicentre of the current Ebola outbreak, is much busier than usual.
items.summary_zh: 布尼亚的尼亚穆龙戈公墓是刚果民主共和国东北部的一座城市,是目前埃博拉疫情的中心,比平时忙得多。

items.title: 'We had to get out of the way': The backlash over delivery robots
items.title_zh: "我们必须让开": 对送货机器人的反弹
items.summary: The first time Chicago resident John Roberts saw a delivery robot trundling down the sidewalk on his street he was impressed.
items.summary_zh: 芝加哥居民约翰·罗伯茨第一次见到一个送货机器人 在他街上的人行道上出事,他印象深刻。

items.title: Japan ramping up defence is 'critical' to prevent war, Defence Minister Koizumi tells BBC
items.title_zh: 国防部长小泉告诉英国广播公司,
items.summary: Japan must "strengthen its defence capabilities", Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi has told the BBC, emphasising the need to revisit the pacifist posture that has defined the country since World War Two.
items.summary_zh: 日本必须"加强防御能力",国防部长小泉正次郎已经告诉了英国广播公司,强调需要重新审视二战以来界定了国家的和平主义姿态.

items.title: 'They came with machetes' - deadline looms for migrants to leave South Africa
items.title_zh: "他们带着砍刀来了" "移民离开南非的最后期限快到了"
items.summary: South Africa has become a hostile place for undocumented migrants, as a deadline set by protesters for them to leave the country approaches.
items.summary_zh: 南非已成为无证移民的敌对地,

items.title: 'Warning fire went up': Couple on board yacht describe encounter with Russian warship
items.title_zh: "警告火势上升": 乘坐游艇的夫妇描述与俄国军舰相遇
items.summary: Retired British couple Jane and Alan Kelvey spoke to BBC's Newsnight after coming into close contact with Russian frigate the Admiral Grigorovich on Tuesday morning.
items.summary_zh: 退休的英国夫妇简和艾伦·凯尔维在星期二早上与"格里戈罗维奇"上将号俄国护卫舰密切接触后,与BBC的"新闻之夜"进行了交谈.

items.title: Drones create the first-ever Fifa scoreboard in Seattle sky
items.title_zh: 无人机创造了西雅图天空首个菲法记分牌
items.summary: BBC reporter Max Matza is in Seattle, Washington, where 400 drones lit up the night sky on Monday to display the score of the Egypt v Belgium match.
items.summary_zh: BBC记者马克斯·马特扎在华盛顿西雅图,周一有400架无人机点亮了夜空来展示埃及与比利时的比分.
